Description

Hi! I'm Eric. Eric·ZDW is a solo project. Gameplay is emotional; I want to make games from my heart. The initials "ZDW" come from the names of me and my parents.

History

I've been playing games for over 20 years, and wanted to take a crack at it myself. I like to listen to lot of music, watch a lot of movies, read a lot of books, but was always drawn to the unique qualities of games.
